title: Cohomology properties of maps in (Cat) : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

errors: No mathematical errors. Notation is slightly sloppy: in (b)(iii) the target should read H_X(f_{U'}u', f_{Y'}y') rather than H_X(u,y).
In (b), compatibility should be stated as U' = f^{-1}(U), Y' = f^{-1}(Y). This is implicit in 'defining decomposition'.
In (a), the conditions (i), (ii) mean that f_U and f_Y are the restrictions ('induced by f'). The words 'inducing f' reverse the direction.

ideas.what: A category with a complementary pair (full subcategory U, full subcategory Y with no maps Y→U) is equivalent to the data (U, Y, profunctor U^op×Y→Ens)
ideas.modern_name: collage/cograph of a profunctor; categories over Δ^1 ≃ profunctors
ideas.where_published: Similar recollement/cograph considerations are in Pursuing Stacks and Les Dérivateurs; exact form unsure

ideas.what: Universal property of the collage: functors X→Z are triples (f_U, f_Y, natural map H→Hom_Z(f_U-, f_Y-))
ideas.modern_name: universal property of the collage (lax colimit/cograph)

ideas.what: Morphisms, products with T, and Δ^1-homotopies of decomposed categories expressed via the profunctor data
ideas.modern_name: functoriality of the collage construction; Cat/Δ^1 is cartesian over Cat

deep.surprise_reason: These are routine, correct bookkeeping notes on collages of profunctors (recollement data in Cat) and their maps, products and homotopies. The material is standard and well known in the literature.
transcription_corrections: 'inducing [?] f' should read 'induced by f' (restrictions of f), in both (i) and (ii).
In (b)(iii), 'bifunctorial [?]' reads 'bifunctorial'. The target is H_X(f u', f y').
In (d), the interval is written as a bold I overwritten with Δ (Δ^1 / I). The transcription's Δ^1 is reasonable.
In (d), the marginal note reads roughly 'U', Y' suitable for h_i^{-1}(U), h_i^{-1}(Y), i ∈ {0,1}'. It means U', Y' are the common inverse images under both ends h_0, h_1.
